preregistered_note: Frozen BEFORE the first harness metrics run; no benchmark results had been observed when these bounds were chosen. Rationale: DevDoc P1b target magnitudes (1H MAE < 0.1 ppm, 13C MAE < 2 ppm) and gap section 10.3 (non-inferiority bounds fixed before results; molecule-clustered paired confidence intervals). These bounds apply to benchmark datasets; a metric with no data compares as NOT_VERIFIED, never as pass. Re-freezing requires an explicit re-measurement note via refreeze_thresholds (recorded in 'remeasurements').

absent_confident_winner_rate.rationale: When the true structure is absent, a confident (DP4 >= 0.5) winner in more than 60% of cases is a false-confidence signal; refusal or low confidence is the desired behavior.

assignment_accuracy.rationale: Gap section 10.3 layer-2 assigned-statistical set: automatic assignment must recover reference labels on at least 90% of paired signals.

brier_dp5.rationale: A balanced positive/negative construction has chance Brier 0.25; the model must beat chance on the benchmark before any calibration claim.

item_refusal_rate.rationale: Share of items with no valid candidate; same 30% representativeness bound.

log_loss_dp5.rationale: Chance log-loss on a balanced set is ln 2 ~ 0.693; bound sits just above chance and is tightened by re-measurement.

refusal_rate.rationale: Gap section 10.3 requires reporting the failure/refusal share; more than 30% non-valid candidates makes aggregate metrics unrepresentative.

shift_mae_13c_ppm.rationale: DevDoc P1b target magnitude for 13C MAE (< 2 ppm) on assigned benchmark datasets.

shift_mae_1h_ppm.rationale: DevDoc P1b target magnitude for 1H MAE (< 0.1 ppm).

shift_rmse_13c_ppm.rationale: RMSE bound slightly looser than MAE; heavy-tail residuals must not hide behind the mean.

shift_rmse_1h_ppm.rationale: RMSE bound slightly looser than MAE for 1H.

top1_dp4.rationale: Gap section 10.3: candidate Top-1 (true structure ranked first) target ~90% magnitude; below this the dataset is exploratory.

top1_dp5.rationale: Same Top-1 bar when a DP5 probability is available; measured separately because null DP5 is excluded, never zeroed.
